title: Instrument shopping list file and document boundaries
description: Add structured debug logs to shopping-list file IO and document parsing choke points, including discovery, read/write, folder resolution, and markdown document initialization summaries.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingListFiles.discover(in:)` logs entry with folder URL and exit with discovered markdown file count.
`ShoppingListFiles.readText(from:)` and `writeText(_:to:)` log entry/exit with public file paths and non-sensitive result details.
`ShoppingListFiles.shoppingListsURL(in:)` logs first-use resolution describing whether the subfolder existed or was created.
`ShoppingListDocument.init(markdown:)` emits a debug summary of parsed aisles/items and notes/meals presence without logging full content.

handoff_summary.completed: All four acceptance criteria met: discover logs entry folder and exit count; readText and writeText log entry/exit with file paths and non-sensitive details; shoppingListsURL logs whether the subfolder was reused or newly created; ShoppingListDocument.init(markdown:) emits a debug summary of aisles/items/notes/meals presence without logging content.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. ShoppingListDocument.swift in CookbookCore now carries its own private Logger (same subsystem/category as CookbookApp's Loggers.shoppingLists) rather than sharing the Loggers namespace — intentional given package boundary.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify log emissions under simulated file IO scenarios.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. Changes are additive (logging only) with no shared mutable state.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: CookbookCore's ShoppingListDocument uses a private file-level Logger with the same subsystem/category (com.cookbookapp / shoppingLists) as the app-level Loggers.shoppingLists, keeping log streams unified without introducing a cross-package dependency on the Loggers namespace. ShoppingListFiles uses url.lastPathComponent (not full path) in read/write logs to keep paths short while remaining non-sensitive.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Existing ShoppingListFilesTests cover the IO paths but do not assert log output. A tester bead could add log capture assertions or verify via OSLog stream in integration.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: shoppingListsURL is called from within discover's already-active security scope, resulting in a double-bracket on folderURL. This was pre-existing behaviour; logging was added around the existing call without restructuring.

conflict_risks: None. Changes are additive (logging only) with no shared mutable state.

execution_history.summary: Instrumented shopping-list file IO and document parsing with structured debug logs. Added entry/exit logs to ShoppingListFiles (discover, readText, writeText, shoppingListsURL) using the existing Loggers.shoppingLists logger. Added a file-local os.Logger in CookbookCore's ShoppingListDocument to emit a post-parse summary (aisles, items, hasNotes, hasMeals). Build verified clean.
